title: Add HTML jobs dashboard to async job queue API
description: Brownfield Python/FastAPI task: add a GET /jobs/ui endpoint that returns an HTML table of all jobs and their statuses.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a new HTML endpoint to src/app.py. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

  GET /jobs/ui
    — returns an HTMLResponse with a simple HTML page listing all jobs
    — the page must include an HTML <table> with columns: ID and Status
    — each job in _jobs appears as a <tr> with its id and status
    — register this route BEFORE GET /jobs/{job_id} to avoid path shadowing

Import HTMLResponse from fastapi.responses.
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
